title: Frontend dependency can be swapped to phish users into approving the router
root_cause: The dapp frontend loads a third-party script over a mutable CDN; if that script is replaced, users can be tricked into signing a malicious approval to the router.
attacker_entrypoint: Attacker compromises the CDN and serves a malicious script; victim signs an approval via phishing UI.

severity_justification.realistic_case: Requires both an infra compromise and a successful phish.

bounty_program_mapping.scope_reference: https://immunefi.com/bounty/exampleprotocol/#scope (smart contracts only; frontend & social engineering out of scope)

call_trace: off-chain: malicious script -> user signs ERC20.approve(router, max)
asset_delta: Up to the victim's full token balance, contingent on phishing success.
false_positive_risks: This is an off-chain/social-engineering risk, not a smart-contract vulnerability.
invalidating_conditions: Out of scope: frontend, infrastructure, and social engineering are excluded by the program.

defense_analysis.why_it_fails: Mitigation is off-chain and out of the contract scope.

assumptions: Attacker can compromise the CDN and phish a victim.
triager_summary: Depends on compromised infrastructure and phishing, both explicitly out of scope. Must not be submitted.
